plugin.files.tree.request.description: One tree request of the plugin host to the files sidecar (snapshot, expand, collapse or select) and its result; error is the text of the failure and the level is warn for a failed request.

plugin.files.tree.changed.description: The files sidecar reported a change in a watched directory; path is the changed directory relative to the project folder.

plugin.files.tree.failed.description: The files sidecar reported a failure that no request caused; error is its text.

plugin.files.open.failed.description: A file of the tree did not open; error is the refusal that the message row shows.

plugin.files.command.description: The result of a command of the plugin; error is present only when ok is false and the level is warn then.

plugin.files.host.report.description: The view bridge of the plugin host page reported a lost or skipped call or snapshot; kind names the loss and text names its command, status or place. The level is debug for a skipped snapshot and warn for the others.
